operations.content: hermes mcp add keeps only the LAST --env flag and treats everything after --args as args; to set many env vars, run mcp add first then hermes config set mcp_servers.<name>.env.KEY value per key. Never hand-edit config.yaml.

Hermes Tavily uses Neocoder rotator at F:/CD/Opencode/.opencode/tools/tavily-rotator/launcher.mjs with 20 TAVILY_API_KEY_1..20 in config plus TAVILY_DEFAULT_DEPTH=advanced; state file shared with Neocoder; rotator tools are tavily-search/extract/crawl/map/usage (no research tool).
